spec: docs/omnirush-project-archive.md (subscription-manager), section "Seal format"; reference implementation in its appendix A
notes: All binary values are lowercase hex unless the key ends in _b64 (RFC 4648 base64, padded).
Vectors named chunk16_* use the vector-only header variant "chunk":16 so every framing case stays small; real_chunk_* use the production chunk 1048576.
Every positive vector is sealed with keys.ephemeral and salt; an encoder given the same ephemeral private key, salt, chunk and plaintext must reproduce sealed_hex (or sealed_sha256) byte for byte.
Decoders are given decoder_kids (current key first, then the previous one) for every vector.
A negative vector must be rejected with exactly expect_error and must not be reported as a success.

previous.derivation: sha256(b'omnirush-seal-v1 test vector: previous server key')

positive.name: chunk16_empty
positive.description: Empty plaintext: one final frame holding only the 16-byte tag.

positive.name: chunk16_5_bytes
positive.description: Five bytes, shorter than one chunk: one short final frame.

positive.name: chunk16_exactly_1_chunk
positive.description: Exactly one chunk: one full-length frame that is final (no empty trailer frame).

positive.name: chunk16_exactly_2_chunks
positive.description: Exactly two chunks: a full non-final frame then a full final frame.

positive.name: chunk16_2_5_chunks
positive.description: Two and a half chunks: two full non-final frames and a short final frame.

positive.name: chunk16_previous_key
positive.description: Sealed to the previous (rotated-out but still configured) server key; a decoder holding both keys must open it.

positive.name: real_chunk_5_bytes
positive.description: Production header (chunk 1048576) with a five-byte plaintext.

positive.name: real_chunk_2_5_chunks
positive.description: Production header, 2.5 MiB plaintext (byte i = i mod 251): frames of 1048576, 1048576 and 524288 plaintext bytes. Too large to inline: compare sealed_sha256 and the per-frame digests.

negative.name: flipped_tag
negative.description: Last tag byte of frame 0 flipped.

negative.name: flipped_ciphertext
negative.description: First ciphertext byte of frame 1 flipped.

negative.name: truncated_final_frame_removed
negative.description: The final frame is dropped: the stream ends after a full frame sealed as non-final. The decoder opens the last frame as final, fails, retries it as non-final, succeeds, and reports truncation.

negative.name: truncated_final_frame_partial
negative.description: The last 5 bytes of the final frame are cut off.

negative.name: truncated_length_prefix
negative.description: The stream ends 2 bytes into the final frame's length prefix.

negative.name: header_only
negative.description: Magic and header, no frame at all (a final frame is mandatory, even for empty plaintext).

negative.name: extra_frame_after_final
negative.description: A correctly authenticated frame 3 (sealed with the right key, index 3, final=1) appended after the short final frame 2.

negative.name: extra_frame_after_full_final
negative.description: A correctly authenticated frame 1 appended after a full-length final frame 0. The decoder opens frame 0 as non-final (bytes follow), fails, retries it as final, succeeds, and reports frame_after_final.

negative.name: trailing_garbage
negative.description: Three stray bytes after the final frame.

negative.name: swapped_frames
negative.description: Frames 0 and 1 swapped (both full, non-final).

negative.name: wrong_kid
negative.description: A well-formed seal to a key the decoder does not hold (kid 813163b40df6d9d8); rejected before any key agreement.

negative.name: bad_magic
negative.description: Magic ORSEAL02 instead of ORSEAL01.

negative.name: short_input
negative.description: Three bytes: not even a magic.

negative.name: unsupported_version
negative.description: A header with "v":2, otherwise consistent.

negative.name: header_extra_key
negative.description: The header carries an extra key "x"; only the seven v1 keys are allowed.

negative.name: header_wrong_content
negative.description: The header says "content":"tar"; v1 archives are "tar+zstd".

negative.name: header_chunk_too_small
negative.description: The header says "chunk":15 (minimum 16).

negative.name: header_len_too_large
negative.description: header_len 4097 (maximum 4096).

negative.name: low_order_epk
negative.description: The epk is the all-zero point, which gives an all-zero X25519 shared secret.

negative.name: oversized_frame_length
negative.description: Frame 0 length prefix says chunk+17 (33) bytes; the maximum is chunk+16.

negative.name: undersized_frame_length
negative.description: Frame 0 length prefix says 15 bytes, shorter than a tag.
